positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description: Worked on many internal tools for the GSF Tech team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Pivoted within the team to work Fidelity's top digital initiative to completely re-write the asset allocation optimization platform.  Developed a RESTful AWS hosted microservice application from scratch within a complex distributed system.  Also helped implement features for the primary portfolio construction engine.  Technologies worked with on a day-to-day basis include Oracle SQL, Java/Spring, TypeScript/Angular, Kafka, and AWS.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Went through Fidelity's LEAP leadership program during the fall of 2018 and built a web-based application for Fidelity's insurance business.  Moved into a role with Asset Management and implemented key functionality for one of the industry leading Tax Aware Optimization platforms.  Received multiple awards for mitigating production issues.

positions.title: DTLP Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Lead developer for the Web HMI (Web-Based Human Machine Interface) product to be used in the new GE9X commercial aircraft engine.  Worked directly with stakeholders at GE’s Aviation plant in Lynn, MA to fine-tune the final product

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description: Worked on reducing costs of annual UPS bills by studying patterns and recognizing wasteful purchases.  Performed statistical analysis on customers surrounding the 5 Mitchell clothing stores, to improve marketing and in-store events.
